spans.claim: John Waring was found dead in his study with a stab wound
spans.anchor: Doctor Waring—as you see him now
spans.span: I broke in at that glass door, being unable to get in any other way, and I found Doctor Waring-as you see him now.

spans.claim: The study door was locked from the inside
spans.anchor: The study door is locked

spans.claim: No weapon was found at the scene
spans.anchor: No weapon about

spans.claim: Anita Austin possessed money and a ruby pin belonging to Waring
spans.anchor: roll of bills—exactly one hundred dollars worth

spans.claim: Anita Austin's fingerprints and dress button imprints were found on a chair in the study
spans.anchor: finger prints on the chair
spans.span: Lockwood, fresh finger prints on the chair which stood near Doctor Waring's desk.

spans.claim: Nogi, the Japanese servant, disappeared after the death
spans.anchor: Nogi is gone
spans.span: Nogi is gone-he cannot be questioned.

spans.claim: Lockwood smoothed the chair back to erase incriminating marks
spans.anchor: carefully smoothing the plush of the little chair
spans.span: Lockwood was coming to breakfast, and I perceived him carefully smoothing the plush of the little chair, sir.

spans.claim: A red circular mark was found on Waring's forehead
spans.anchor: There was a red circle on Waring’s forehead
spans.span: There was a red circle on Waring's forehead, that looked as if it had been put there of some purpose.

spans.claim: Waring opened the small window and put his hand out
spans.anchor: he opened it. But for a moment—Did he put his hand out?

spans.claim: The missing icicle was the murder weapon that melted
spans.anchor: the fringe of icicles that hung from that particular window sash showed one missing
spans.span: Stone did so, and without doubt, the fringe of icicles that hung from that particular window sash showed one missing!

spans.claim: Waring stabbed himself with the icicle
spans.anchor: he decided to stab himself with an icicle, and he did
spans.span: he decided to stab himself with an icicle, and he did.

spans.claim: The Latin epigram describes a death by falling ice
spans.anchor: Book IV, Epigram 18
spans.span: Aloud, the detective read this: TRANSLATION Book IV, Epigram 18 On a youth killed by the fall of a piece of ice.

spans.claim: Anita Austin is John Waring’s secret daughter
spans.anchor: Doctor John Waring was my father
spans.span: Doctor John Waring was my father.

spans.claim: Waring gave Anita money and a ruby pin as gifts
spans.anchor: He gave me the money, for he was afraid I hadn’t sufficient cash
spans.span: He gave me the money, for he was afraid I hadn't sufficient cash with me, and he gave me the ruby pin, saying I must keep it forever as my father's first gift to me.

spans.claim: Waring locked the study door after Anita left
spans.anchor: he softly opened the glass door for me. I went away and he closed the door

spans.claim: Nogi witnessed the death and fled
spans.anchor: I was afraid, and I ran away—fast
spans.span: I was afraid, and I ran away-fast.

spans.claim: Lockwood loved Anita and tried to protect her
spans.anchor: I love you, I believe in you and I want you
spans.span: I know you are in no way guiltily connected with this crime-if you are mixed up with it, it is through force of circumstances, and anyway, I don't care who or what you are-I love you, I believe in you and I want you.

spans.claim: Maurice Trask tried to manipulate Anita with threats and proposals
spans.anchor: Marry me, and I’ll clear you of all suspicion

spans.claim: The red ring mark was caused by resting on the telephone
spans.anchor: he rested his head on the instrument
spans.span: Without doubt, Doctor Waring was telephoning-or perhaps was answering a call and he rested his head on the instrument.

spans.claim: The case was solved by reenactment and examination of the icicle
spans.anchor: Nogi was made to imitate the movements he saw Doctor Waring make
